title: wb init team's first --apply rendered the mediator's moniker in the roster README where its display name belongs
body: Raised by agentic-engineering-vc on 2026-11-13. In the agentic-engineering project, the first intent wb init team --apply wrote the mediator's moniker into intent/whiteboard/README.md where the display name belongs, and a later re-render put it right (that project's commits 63ae6fd and f71d34c, 2026-11-12, on 3.3.0 or 3.3.1). It has not been reproduced on 3.3.2. First step: reproduce it in a fresh project under an isolated HOME, then fix the first render if it still happens.
